rough_hierarchy

Source: R/network_analysis.R
rough_hierarchy.Rd

returns rough roots in the network, rough roots selected as those connected to most number of nodes

Usage

rough_hierarchy(network_table, abs_weight = TRUE, directed = TRUE)

Arguments

network_table

The weight data table of network.

abs_weight

Whether to use absolute weight values.

directed

Whether the network is directed.

Value

list

Examples

data("example_matrix", package = "inferCSN")
network_table <- inferCSN::inferCSN(example_matrix)
#> ℹ [2026-09-11 09:40:35] Inferring network for <matrix/array>...
#> ◌ [2026-09-11 09:40:35] Checking parameters...
#> ✔ [2026-09-11 09:40:35] Inferring network done
#> ℹ [2026-09-11 09:40:35] Network information:
#> ℹ                         Edges Regulators Targets
#> ℹ                       1    12          6       6
rough_hierarchy(network_table)
#> $roots
#> [1] "g6" "g2" "g4" "g5" "g3" "g1"
#> 
#> $num_paths
#> [1] 6
#>
